tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Find businesses in the directory by what they do (query, category: a group or a place category), where (near, country), the language they speak, whether they are open now, their attributes (list_attributes), price band, what their doors take and what they accept (accepts), whether a door answers ask

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: One business's full listing, by its domain: its address (a town and country for one this network found), the week's opening hours and closures, its doors and what each takes, its services, its standing in words, a member's track record (promises kept, broken and still open, and when, once enough hav

tools.name: check_business
tools.description: Checks what an AI agent can do with a business's website: message, book, order, sign up, pay, change or cancel. Waits up to 25 seconds; if the read isn't finished, returns what it found so far, and you call it again for the score. A result read in the last hour is answered as it is; after a business

tools.name: report_door
tools.description: After you use a business's door (its inbox, MCP, A2A or API), say how it went: it answered (ok), refused (slot_taken, out_of_stock…), the request was your own fault (invalid), it failed (could not connect, a server or tool error), or it needs a person (info). Report every use, done or not, up to 100

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The categories list: every slug with its English and Portuguese labels and its kind (local_and_retail, or software_and_ai for software, API and AI companies, kept apart). Pass a slug as category to search_businesses.

tools.name: list_attributes
tools.description: The attributes a search may ask for (delivery, walk_ins, wifi…), each with its labels, and the payments accepts takes. Pass keys as attributes to search_businesses, and payments as accepts.

tools.name: register_business
tools.description: For a business's own AI: put the business in this directory with its doors (MCP, A2A, OpenAPI, an API, UCP, ACP, a platform's door) and its facts: name, what it is (a category of list_categories or a place category, and one line), where (a storefront, a service area, or online with the countries it

tools.name: update_business
tools.description: For a business's own AI: correct its listing (set any field register_business takes), add or remove doors, turn the listing off or on, or hide its agentic score result (score_page), with its claim_token or a proof as register_business asks. opt_out stops this network listing the site (list), reading

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_businesses, check_business, report_door · Private data: get_business, report_door, register_business · Public sink: report_door · Destructive: update_business.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_businesses, check_business, report_door · Private data: get_business, report_door, register_business · Public sink: report_door · Destructive: update_business

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
